description: The shared method and tools of the CEET meta-skills: interview protocol and consent, synthesis rules, the pack contract, a deterministic renderer with tool adapters, the pack validator, checks, decision retrieval and fidelity measurement.

tools.name: ceet_interview
tools.description: Records consent and verbatim answers of a CEET interview, and says what to ask next from the gaps in the profile.

tools.name: ceet_render_pack
tools.description: Renders a pack from its cognitive profile (dry run first), runs the teachback, installs adapters and erases a pack.

tools.name: ceet_validate_pack
tools.description: Validates an interview or simulated pack against its role: consent, slots, references, evidence, privacy, drift.

tools.name: ceet_examples
tools.description: Retrieves the person's real decisions closest to a task from a pack's examples.

tools.name: ceet_check
tools.description: Runs a pack's mechanical checks (secrets, commit message format, banned patterns) and their bench.

tools.name: ceet_fidelity
tools.description: Measures how well a pack decides like its person against held-out decisions and their own consistency.
